q: What are the emissions of spraying crops with a drone?
title: Drone crop spraying emissions
short: An electric spraying drone uses battery charge, so emissions are the charging electricity times 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, or genset diesel if charged in the field. Per acre that is small next to tractor spraying. The pesticide itself has its own footprint.
audience: Drone service providers and farmer groups

ol: kWh per battery charge times charges per day.
Times 0.710, or genset litres times 2.68 kg.

p: The drone operator reports charging as Scope 2 or genset diesel as Scope 1. The farmer hiring the service puts it in Scope 3.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector
